response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment AS e INNER JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_image_count, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM matched) AS image_average_difference FROM matched GROUP BY entrystat;
